rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and uses the provided 3AA grade appropriately, but it overstates image-visible certainty: the ICM is not clearly well-defined/tightly packed on this image, TE cohesion/uniformity is difficult to confirm, and claims such as no multinucleation/vacuolization are not reliably assessable here.
Thoroughly integrates age, AMH, oocyte yield, tubal factor diagnosis, semen parameters, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a plausible prognosis estimate tied to morphology and age; minor issues include somewhat overstating the impact of AMH on euploidy and attributing failure mainly to aneuploidy.

Core recommendations such as proceeding with single embryo transfer are guideline-concordant, but several adjunct suggestions (routine DHEA, growth hormone, embryo banking/PGT-A framing, and definitive advice against assisted hatching) are more controversial or not strongly guideline-based.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, though some suggestions are more speculative than standard and would benefit from stronger prioritization.
